note: Target Romanesque-painting section on Santa Maria de Mur documents the 1919 removal, dealer Ignasi Pollack, removal crew led by Franco Steffanoni, and the Catalan Museums Board's unsuccessful attempt to stop it; the same section notes export law and later museum ownership. This supports the bridge's distinction about removal crews, dealers, and museum ownership.
sentence: It is a different problem from what happened to [Romanesque frescoes stripped from Catalan churches](/romanesque-painting/) in the same general period, whose documented dispute concerned removal crews, dealers and museum ownership.
